story: On Thursday, Zoe and her sister Lucy prepare for a dinner party. They cook pizza and look at the menu. They must not forget the small details like the fire or the toothpaste.
title: A Busy Thursday
setting: A cozy kitchen and dining room.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: A young girl with short brown hair and a green shirt.

characters.name: Lucy
characters.look: A young girl with long blonde hair and a red sweater.

characters.name: Mister Raj
characters.look: A tall man with glasses and a blue shirt.

sentences.en: It is a busy Thursday for Zoe.
sentences.zh: 这对 Zoe 来说是一个忙碌的星期四。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe with short brown hair and a green shirt stands in a kitchen.

sentences.en: Zoe and her sister Lucy cook pizza.
sentences.zh: Zoe 和她的妹妹 Lucy 做比萨饼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe and Lucy with long blonde hair are making pizza on a table.

sentences.en: Lucy looks at the food menu.
sentences.scene_prompt: Lucy with long blonde hair holds a paper menu.

sentences.en: Mister Raj walks through the door.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj, a tall man with glasses, enters through a wooden door.

sentences.en: He brings a pair of yellow bananas.
sentences.zh: 他带来了一双黄色的香蕉。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj holds two yellow bananas in his hands.

sentences.en: Please do not forget the fire.
sentences.scene_prompt: A small orange fire burns in a kitchen stove.

sentences.en: Listen to the music by yourself.
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe sits alone and listens to a small radio.

sentences.en: He uses the last bit of toothpaste.
sentences.scene_prompt: Mister Raj squeezes a small tube of toothpaste.
